<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Parametric depletion requires distinct private-store agents and positive net deficit; OpenComposition fleet viability requires additive post-cap and envCap headroom below H_safe and lag-buffered warnLevel; aliasing theorems assume sampled schedules ReadsAt / sigmaOdd or coupling-depth lower bounds 2 * N - 1 ≤ L.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>

- Uniform aliasing failure under schedules reading every fine recovery step.
- Normative ranking or moral obligation from local depletion or finite-time collapse (ReadsOnlyDynamics.not_entails).
